name: Select Same ID
description: Selects every object with the same ID and editor layer as your selection.

corner.name: Button corner
corner.description: Corner of the editor where the button is placed. Applies the next time the editor opens.

offset-x.name: Offset X
offset-x.description: Horizontal offset of the button from its corner.

offset-y.name: Offset Y
offset-y.description: Vertical offset of the button from its corner.
